notes.text: The shaft — rescuers come down here
Feeding chamber — where the dragged PC ends up
Branch — into the brood's other tunnels

blooming-rot-2.sceneNote: One burrow under the Fallow Ford road, for a PC an ankheg drags down. Daylight shaft top left (eight to ten feet down), forty feet of tunnel to the feeding chamber bottom right, and a side branch that runs off the bottom edge into the rest of the brood's tunnels. Walls follow the painted floor; the only light is late-afternoon sun down the shaft. Token vision is on.
